title: Ask Me Again Differently: GRAS for Measuring Bias in Vision Language Models on Gender, Race, Age, and Skin Tone

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting Vision Language Models with Visual Question Answering (VQA) templates to associate positive and negative personality traits with images of individuals of different genders, and analyzing the probability of 'Yes' responses to quantify positive and negative trait attribution rates.

Prompting Vision Language Models with Visual Question Answering (VQA) templates to associate positive and negative personality traits with images of individuals from different racial groups, and analyzing the probability of 'Yes' responses to quantify positive and negative trait attribution rates.

Prompting Vision Language Models with Visual Question Answering (VQA) templates to associate positive and negative personality traits with images of individuals from different age groups, and analyzing the probability of 'Yes' responses to quantify positive and negative trait attribution rates.

Prompting Vision Language Models with Visual Question Answering (VQA) templates to associate positive and negative personality traits with images of individuals categorized by the 10-point Monk Skin Tone scale, and analyzing the probability of 'Yes' responses to quantify positive and negative trait attribution rates.
